item.description: Fiona, the hippo whose premature birth and fight for survival at the Cincinnati Zoo turned her into a global sensation nearly a decade ago, died Thursday from complications after swallowing a knit hat that was accidentally flung into her enclosure. item.title: Does staggered consent actually protect young people?
item.description: Following recent scandals involving two iconic British comedians, the UK government is considering the introduction of staggered age consent. Annette Young talks to Katherine Allen from the Institute of Social Justice and Crime in the UK about whether such laws work. Also the social costs of femicide; how do loved ones cope with such a loss, and what support is available to families in the wake of such a tragedy? Plus we meet the women who are challenging the traditions of Mexican mariachi music, a world that remains largely male dominated. Fuente: France 24 - English.
